components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dominant controller commitment for the current phase.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { width: 100%; min-height: 3.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 0.8rem 1rem; background: var(--orange); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0.35rem 0 var(--orange-dark); font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 760; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-primary-button:hover { background: var(--orange); box-shadow: 0 0.35rem 0 var(--orange-dark); } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 0.1875rem solid var(--mint); outline-offset: 0.1875rem; } .ds-primary-button:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Controller Docket
components.description: The private paper work surface centered on a player's phone.
components.html:
HOW TO PLAY

Three moves. One truth.

Write a plausible wrong answer, then decide how certain you are.
components.css: .ds-controller-card { width: min(100%, 34rem); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem; padding: clamp(1rem, 5vw, 1.75rem); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0.65rem 0.75rem 0 var(--orange-dark), 0 0.75rem 1.75rem oklch(0.05 0.015 252 / 0.38); font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-controller-card h2 { margin: 0; font: 780 clamp(2.3rem, 11vw, 4rem)/0.92 'Archivo Narrow Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-controller-card p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-paper-tab { align-self: flex-start; padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); box-shadow: 0.2rem 0.25rem 0 var(--orange); font: 780 0.83rem/1.2 'Archivo Narrow Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Split-Flap Cell
components.description: The signature mechanical character cell used for Bureau declarations.
components.css: .ds-flap-word { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.18rem; font: 770 3rem/0.94 'Archivo Narrow Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-flap-word > span { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 0.75em; min-height: 1.18em; padding: 0 0.08em; overflow: hidden; background: var(--flap); color: var(--ivory); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.05em oklch(0.39 0.025 250 / 0.48), 0 0.08em 0.12em oklch(0.05 0.01 250 / 0.65); } .ds-flap-word > span::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; top: 49%; height: 0.055em; background: var(--void); box-shadow: 0 0.035em 0 oklch(0.45 0.025 250 / 0.4); }

components.name: Answer Option
components.description: A private vote row whose selected state reverses and gains an orange boundary.
components.css: .ds-answer-option { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.55rem; background: oklch(0.85 0.04 82); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem oklch(0.65 0.04 75); font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-answer-option input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-answer-letter { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.5rem; aspect-ratio: 1; background: var(--flap); color: var(--orange); font: 800 1.4rem/1 'Archivo Narrow Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-answer-option:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem oklch(0.65 0.04 75); } .ds-answer-option:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 0.1875rem solid var(--mint); outline-offset: 0.1875rem; } .ds-answer-option:has(input:checked) { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.18rem var(--orange); } .ds-answer-option:has(input:checked) .ds-answer-letter { background: var(--orange); color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview:
Bluff Bureau feels like a late-twentieth-century records office whose fixed mechanical information board has been repurposed for improbable facts. Midnight-cobalt enamel, split-flap typography, signal lamps, and stamped paper slips make each phase feel processed by one coherent apparatus rather than arranged as a dashboard of interchangeable cards.

The shared display is monumental, public, and passive; a single prompt, tally, or reveal owns the room at a time. Player controllers translate the same world into tactile paper dockets with one dominant private task. Motion is sparse and mechanical: lamps pulse in steps and truth cells settle into place, while reduced-motion users receive the same hierarchy without animation.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed information-board topology with one decisive state.
Dark enamel public surfaces paired with warm paper controllers.
Condensed, uppercase display typography with readable humanist body copy.
Orange communicates action, mint certifies truth, and magenta marks Bureau identity.
Mechanical depth from hard offsets, inset seams, and restrained ambient lift.

rules.name: The Signal Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Orange means act or attend, mint means verified or successful, and magenta means Bureau identity; do not use these accents as interchangeable decoration.

rules.name: The One Enamel Chassis Rule
rules.body: Public screens stay within the midnight-cobalt family so the changing state reads as one machine, not a new page.

rules.name: The Machine Speaks Narrow Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo Narrow for anything the Bureau declares; use Source Sans 3 for anything that explains what a person should do.

rules.name: The Mechanical Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevation must describe a part, seam, layer, or press state; never add a soft decorative glow merely to make a surface feel premium.

dos: Do give each surface one dominant prompt, task, tally, or reveal.
Do preserve the fixed public rail/content/signal-strip topology across every game phase.
Do use paper material for private controller work and enamel material for public room state.
Do keep controller touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels and preserve the mint keyboard-focus treatment.
Do keep state language literal alongside lamps, colors, stamps, and animation.
donts: Don't turn the public display into a dashboard of equal cards or add host controls to the passive surface.
Don't scatter orange, mint, or magenta as decoration; each accent has a durable semantic job.
Don't round public panels, split-flap cells, stamps, score rows, or answer rows into soft app cards.
Don't use body copy in the condensed display face or long explanations in all caps.
Don't add gradients, glass effects, ornamental glow, or continuous motion that weakens the mechanical apparatus.
